patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Fastmail and Slack share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Fastmail and Slack share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Fastmail only if your buying job matches “Privacy-focused business email, calendar and contacts with custom domains and shared addre” rather than Slack's shape. Choose Slack only if your buying job matches “Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $1” rather than Fastmail's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Fastmail is shaped for Privacy-focused business email, calendar and contacts with custom doma whereas Slack is shaped for Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month . Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Fastmail and Slack share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Fastmail is Privacy-focused business email, calendar and contacts with custom domains and shared addresses — Business Basic from $3/user/month annual; a; Slack is Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $15, Enterprise+ contact sales; huddles for light vi.
- Company-size focus: Fastmail (micro, small-business) vs Slack (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Fastmail — Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications; Slack — Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer.

Limitations — Fastmail: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications; Shared addresses, shared calendars and the shared address book require Standard or above; Slack: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer; No SMS or WhatsApp Business customer channels.

Poor-fit cases: Fastmail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications · Slack is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer · Avoid Fastmail if you actually need Slack's motion (Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Bu)
